planets.name: TrES-1 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TrES-1 with a 3.03-day year, found in 2004.

text.card: TrES-1 b was found in 2004 by TrES as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TrES-1. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2004, disc_facility TrES, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.030069476, pl_radj 1.13, pl_bmassj 0.84

quotes.title: TrES-1b
quotes.card: TrES-1b is an extrasolar planet approximately 523 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra.
quotes.introduction: The planet's mass and radius indicate that it is a Jovian planet with a similar bulk composition to Jupiter.
